about_the_game:
Play as one of three classes, the Knight, the Mage, and the Barbarian in this 3D turn-based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Delve into a dungeon in search of loot and experience while fighting off hoards of skeletons and other enemies.

This game is meant to be played Windowed at an aspect ratio of 8:3 that is not designed to fill a traditional 16:9 monitor screen. The game is built with a small resource footprint so that it can be left running while other programs and games are active. During downtime in your other games, fight, level up, and loot!

Have a long queue for a match lobby in another game? Just Keep Looting!

Waiting for friends in your MMO to travel to your location or come back from AFK? Just Keep Looting!

Boss makes a dollar, you make a dime? That’s why you Just Keep Looting on company time!

Fight

Engage in turn-based combat where your decisions make the difference between victory and defeat.

Level Up

Watch that little bar grow as you defeat enemies and earn experience. Leveling up gives you stat points to allocate and increases your health and mana. Continue leveling forever with no level cap… sort of. Your character can continue to level as long as you continue earning experience. If you reach level 8,200 you will not be able to earn more experience. 

Find Loot

Inspired by many classic ARPG games, find randomly generated stats on items of different rarity. Find the best ones to maximize your gear and bonuses.

Characters

The Knight

Stalwart Fighter using Swords and Shields or Greatswords.

The Mage

Magickal Adept using Wands and magical Orbs or Staves.

The Barbarian

Ferocious Warrior using Axes and Hatchets or Battleaxes.

Level Up and Improve Loot

The transmogrifier will happily take your money in exchange for helping you to update the level of your item or replace bonuses to get the ultimate loot!

Upgrade Loot

Use Magical Reforging to upgrade lower rarity items into a single higher rarity item.

Store

Buy and sell items you collect along the way that aren’t useful. Take that money and do something good with it! The store gives you access to random items to supplement what you find.

Stash

Shared inventory space between your three characters that lets you transfer items between them.

Boss Key

We get it. Sometimes you don’t want someone else to see that you’re playing a game. Instead of minimizing the game, hit the Boss Key! The screen will change to something more productivity friendly like a web browser with too many tabs open or a spreadsheet.

Set out on your own treasure hunt and collect the rarest and most valuable items. Play at your leisure with no time pressure. Save and close then come back to where you were later. The dungeon is deep, and the loot calls to you, it’s time to Just Keep Looting!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

short_description: In Just Keep Looting, play as one of three classes in this 3D turn-based RPG. Fight monsters as you progress deeper and deeper into the dungeon in search of more powerful loot! Designed to play windowed in downtime during other games. Delve into the dungeon and Just Keep Looting!
